input.summary: Make the Company's convenience right express and cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made express that the Company may terminate for convenience and without cause on the existing ninety (90) days' notice against renewal, and we have capped the Section 4.2 Termination Payment at three months of Section 3.1 fees so that our exit is not penalised by an uncapped share of twelve months' Net Sales. This is our fallback position on convenience termination and early-termination fees.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company or HDI for convenience and without cause upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.

ops.text: In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the aggregate payments due from the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
